title.narrative: Transitioning Integrated Health and Protection Interventions toward Sustainable Service Delivery in Syria

description.narrative: Across Syria, the project will apply a harmonised, phased transition roadmap to shift from IMC-led implementation to authority-led, sustainable service delivery while maintaining continuity of essential care. In Year 1, IMC will continue to stabilise and deliver priority integrated health, MHPSS, and protection services in selected facilities and catchments, while simultaneously establishing the building blocks for transition, joint governance and coordination arrangements, agreed service packages and minimum standards, strengthened referral pathways, and structured capacity building and supervision systems. Over the three years, IMC’s role will shift from direct delivery to technical advisory support, mentorship, and quality assurance, with responsibilities and costs gradually transferred to the relevant authorities through formal agreements and sequenced handover plans.
